name: Painter
description: Turns a child's photo and spoken wishes into one simple, bold picture they can copy by hand — kept full-screen on the kids' screen once they say it is done.
description_zh: 把孩子的一张照片和一句句语音愿望画成一幅线条简单、颜色明亮、能照着画的画；孩子说画好了，就满屏一直亮在孩子屏上。

slots.reason: A photo starts the picture; each voice message changes it; the painter's short replies come back here.
slots.reason_zh: 一张照片开始一幅画；每条语音改一处；小画家的简短回复从这里回去。

slots.reason: Shows the picture while it is drawn, with its buttons; a finished picture stays full-screen until the next one. Taps come back as commands.
slots.reason_zh: 画的过程连同按钮显示在这里；画完后满屏一直亮着，直到下一幅。按钮点击作为指令回传。

slots.reason: A voice device in the kids' room can send the wishes too; the painter's one-line reply goes back on the same feed.
slots.reason_zh: 孩子房间的语音设备也可以说愿望；小画家的一句回复从同一频道回去。

resources.reason: Ages and favorite things — how simple the picture should be and what to suggest. Optional.
resources.reason_zh: 年龄和喜欢的东西——决定画多简单、建议画什么。可选。
